notes.title: MUG UPDATE: GAMEPLAY AND OPTIMIZATION IMPROVEMENTS
notes.notes:
[h1]From clicker to idler[/h1]
Now the game starts out as a clicker, but as it progresses it becomes an automatic drink pourer. You can even minimize the window and try to score the maximum number of points!

[h1]Achievement[/h1]
The game had problems with achievements at release. We counted them incorrectly and it was impossible to get them all. We fixed it and checked it again.

[h1]Optimization[/h1]
At launch, due to incorrect settings on our side, the game consumed a lot of video memory. We have fixed this problem - now the game should work adequately on most devices. If you have any problems, please contact us with the configuration of your device.

notes.title: MUG NEW VERSION: new gameplay and improvements
notes.notes:
Thank you for support and feedback. We've done what you ask for!

[h3][b]ACHIEVEMENTS REWORK[/b][/h3]

We've redesigned the achievement system. Now you can definitely get them all.

[h3][b]GAMEPLAY IMPROVEMENTS[/b][/h3]

Now you have more than just a mug at your disposal. Use beer taps to pour mugs automatically!
